mapper.select: select count(1) from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL where TRADE_ID = #{tradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT null outTradeId, /*外部成交编号*/ NVL(deal1.BOOKSET_ID,deal2.BOOKSET_ID) portfolioId,/**金融产品代码**/ bok.BOOKSET_NAME portfolioName,/**金融产品名称**/ zc.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, /**资产代码**/ zc.FINPROD_ABBR finprodName,/**资产名称**/ t.PS ps,/**交易方向**/ t.TRADE_ID tradeId,/**交易编号**/ t.TRADE_DATE tradeDate,/**交易日**/ t.SETTLE_DATE settDate,/**交割日期**/ t.PRIN_AMT prinAmt, /**交易本金**/ mst.COUNTER_NAME counterId, /**交易对手**/ t.INT_AMT intAmt,/**应收利息总额**/ t.CCY ccy,/**币种**/ stl.SETTLE_AMT settleAmt,/**结算金额**/ t.TRADE_AMT dealAmt,/**本币交易金额**/ stl.MY_ACCT_NO trdAcctId /**资金账户**/ from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL t LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT zc on zc.finprod_id = t.finprod_id LEFT JOIN STL_ORDERS stl ON stl.TRADE_ID = t.TRADE_ID AND stl.BUSI_TYPE ='03' AND STL.ORDER_TYPE NOT LIKE 'N%' LEFT JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING deal1 on deal1.BUSI_NO = t.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING deal2 ON stl.ORDER_ID = deal2.BUSI_NO LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET bok on (bok.BOOKSET_ID = deal1.BOOKSET_ID) OR (bok.BOOKSET_ID = deal2.BOOKSET_ID) LEFT JOIN MST_COUNTER_PARTY mst on mst.COUNTER_ID = t.COUNTER_ID where t.BUSI_TYPE ='03' and t.PS in ('T01','T02') and t.FINPROD_TYPE = 'F07'
and t.TRADE_ID like concat(concat('%',#{tradeId}),'%')
and deal.BOOKSET_ID IN
#{portfolioId}
and zc.FINPROD_MARKET_ID IN
#{finprodMarketId}
and t.TRADE_DATE >= to_date(#{tradeDateBegin},'yyyy-mm-dd')
and t.TRADE_DATE <= to_date(#{tradeDateEnd},'yyyy-mm-dd')
AND t.PS IN
#{ps}
order by t.TRADE_ID desc

SELECT t.TRADE_ID tradeId,/**交易编号**/ null outTradeId, /*外部成交编号*/ NVL(deal1.BOOKSET_ID,deal2.BOOKSET_ID) portfolioId,/**金融产品代码**/ bok.BOOKSET_NAME portfolioName,/**金融产品名称**/ zc.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, /**资产代码**/ zc.FINPROD_ABBR finprodName,/**资产名称**/ t.PS ps,/**交易方向**/ t.TRADE_DATE tradeDate,/**交易日**/ t.SETTLE_DATE settDate,/**交割日期**/ t.PRIN_AMT prinAmt, /**交易本金**/ mst.COUNTER_ID counterId, /**交易对手**/ t.INT_AMT intAmt,/**应收利息总额**/ t.CCY ccy,/**币种**/ stl.SETTLE_AMT settleAmt,/**结算金额**/ t.TRADE_AMT dealAmt,/**本币交易金额**/ stl.MY_ACCT_NO trdAcctId /**资金账户**/ from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL t LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT zc on zc.finprod_id = t.finprod_id LEFT JOIN MST_COUNTER_PARTY mst on mst.COUNTER_ID = t.COUNTER_ID LEFT JOIN STL_ORDERS stl ON stl.TRADE_ID = t.TRADE_ID AND stl.BUSI_TYPE ='03' AND STL.ORDER_TYPE NOT LIKE 'N%' LEFT JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING deal1 on deal1.BUSI_NO = t.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING deal2 ON stl.ORDER_ID = deal2.BUSI_NO LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET bok on (bok.BOOKSET_ID = deal1.BOOKSET_ID) OR (bok.BOOKSET_ID = deal2.BOOKSET_ID) where t.BUSI_TYPE ='03' and t.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and rownum=1
